title: kubectl cluster access
whyItMatters: The kube folder holds cluster addresses and embedded client certificates or tokens. With it a stranger can talk to the clusters the person administered, and the names show which company systems they touched.
source: Kubernetes docs, organizing cluster access: kubeconfig defaults to $HOME/.kube/config: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/organize-cluster-access-kubeconfig/
notes: config is the default kubeconfig; cache holds discovery and http caches. KUBECONFIG can point somewhere else and some tools write several files into this folder.
